title: FedSEAM: Federated Continual Learning of LLMs via Subspace Expert Agreement Merging
abstract: arXiv:2610.33496v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Federated continual learning trains a model on a sequence of tasks across several clients without sharing their data while retaining knowledge of earlier tasks. Sparse mixture-of-experts models support this setting by adapting selected parameters on a frozen backbone. However, clients learn different expert content as tasks evolve, making it difficult to share knowledge across clients without disrupting task-specific and client-specific specialization. Matching tile coordinates alone does not establish whether their learned content is compatible. We present FedSEAM, a federated continual learning framework that organizes task knowledge into sparse experts and selectively shares their content across tasks and clients. On each client, task-aware tile selection allocates capacity to a new task, while a subspace-based compatibility test determines which existing expert tiles to reuse and where to introduce fresh capacity. translated_title: FedSEAM：基于子空间专家一致性合并的大语言模型联邦持续学习
translated_abstract: 联邦持续学习旨在不共享各客户端数据的前提下，跨多个客户端在一系列任务上训练模型，同时保留对早期任务的知识。稀疏混合专家模型通过在冻结的主干网络上调整选定参数来支持这一设定。然而，随着任务的演进，各客户端学习到的专家内容各不相同，这使得在不破坏任务特定与客户端特定专精化的情况下进行跨客户端知识共享变得困难。仅凭瓦片坐标的匹配并不能判断其学习到的内容是否兼容。我们提出了FedSEAM，这是一个联邦持续学习框架，它将任务知识组织为稀疏专家，并在任务与客户端之间选择性地共享其内容。在每个客户端上，任务感知的瓦片选择为新任务分配容量，同时基于子空间的兼容性测试决定复用哪些已有的专家瓦片、以及在哪里引入新的容量。在服务器端，（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: FedSEAM提出了一种联邦持续学习框架，通过将任务知识组织为稀疏专家、在客户端利用任务感知瓦片选择与基于子空间的兼容性测试决定复用或新建专家容量，并在服务器端仅对子空间内容一致兼容的专家进行合并，从而在不破坏任务与客户端特定专精化的前提下实现跨客户端的知识共享。
en_tdlr: FedSEAM is a federated continual learning framework that organizes task knowledge into sparse experts, uses task-aware tile selection and subspace-based compatibility tests on each client to decide whether to reuse or create expert capacity, and merges only content-compatible experts on the server via subspace expert agreement merging, enabling cross-client knowledge sharing without disrupting task- and client-specific specialization.
